WITH recovered AS (
  UPDATE leads
  SET
    status     = 'enriched',
    updated_at = NOW()
  WHERE status = 'auditing'
    AND updated_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '20 minutes'
  RETURNING id
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS stuck_leads_recovered FROM recovered;

WITH picked AS (
  SELECT id
  FROM leads
  WHERE status = 'enriched'
    AND email IS NOT NULL
    AND TRIM(email) <> ''
  ORDER BY created_at ASC
  LIMIT {{ $('config').first().json.batchSize }}
  FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
)
UPDATE leads l
SET
  status     = 'auditing',
  updated_at = NOW()
FROM picked
WHERE l.id = picked.id
RETURNING
  l.id,
  l.business_name,
  l.category,
  l.city,
  COALESCE(l.state, '') AS state,
  COALESCE(l.country, 'US') AS country,
  l.website_url,
  COALESCE(l.email, '') AS email,
  COALESCE(l.facebook_url, '') AS facebook_url,
  COALESCE(l.instagram_url, '') AS instagram_url,
  l.rating,
  l.review_count,
  l.campaign_id;

UPDATE leads SET
  status               = 'pending_review',
  pagespeed_mobile     = {{ $('Code — Compile Audit & Call AI').item.json.pagespeed_mobile !== null ? $('Code — Compile Audit & Call AI').item.json.pagespeed_mobile : 'NULL' }},
  pagespeed_desktop    = {{ $('Code — Compile Audit & Call AI').item.json.pagespeed_desktop !== null ? $('Code — Compile Audit & Call AI').item.json.pagespeed_desktop : 'NULL' }},
  seo_score            = {{ $('Code — Compile Audit & Call AI').item.json.seo_score !== null ? $('Code — Compile Audit & Call AI').item.json.seo_score : 'NULL' }},
  website_pain_points  = '{{ JSON.stringify($('Code — Compile Audit & Call AI').item.json.website_pain_points || []).replace(/'/g, "''") }}'::jsonb,
  social_pain_points   = '{{ JSON.stringify($('Code — Compile Audit & Call AI').item.json.social_pain_points || []).replace(/'/g, "''") }}'::jsonb,
  failure_reason       = NULL,
  audited_at           = NOW(),
  updated_at           = NOW()
WHERE id = {{ $('Code — Compile Audit & Call AI').item.json.id }};

UPDATE leads SET
  retry_count    = retry_count + 1,
  failure_reason = '{{ ($json.failure_reason || "Audit or email generation failed").replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  status         = CASE
                     WHEN retry_count + 1 >= {{ $('config').first().json.maxRetries }}
                     THEN 'audit_failed'
                     ELSE 'enriched'
                   END,
  updated_at     = NOW()
WHERE id = {{ $json.id }};

INSERT INTO workflow_logs (
  workflow_name,
  run_at,
  leads_processed,
  leads_failed,
  duration_ms,
  notes
)
SELECT
  'audit_and_draft',
  NOW(),
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'pending_review' AND updated_at >= '{{ $json.run_start_ts }}'::timestamptz),
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'audit_failed'   AND updated_at >= '{{ $json.run_start_ts }}'::timestamptz),
  {{ $json.duration_ms }},
  '{{ $json.notes.replace(/'/g, "''") }}'
FROM leads;
